dedupe_keys.name: code and data for a real time structural seismic response prediction framework based on transfer learning and unsupervised learning

description: Code and Data for a Real-time Structural Seismic Response Prediction Framework based on Transfer Learning and Unsupervised Learning is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Hongrak Pak, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). Conventional data-driven methods for predicting the seismic response of structures often require extensive data and computational resources. To address these challenges, we here publish a deep learning framework - code and data - that can efficiently and accurately predict the structural seismic responses. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 8 top-level files (PY, JSON). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fx45-dd16. Keywords: Seismic response, SSR network, Transfer learning, Unsupervised learning, Long short-term memory (LSTM). Published 2023-06-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
